headline: Bradesco and Itaú raise mortgage interest rates in Brazil
summary: Major Brazilian banks Bradesco and Itaú have increased interest rates on home loans, with Itaú's minimum rate rising to 12.95%. The two banks accounted for over 41% of savings-funded credit in 2026.
why: Rising mortgage rates in Brazil reflect broader monetary tightening and fiscal concerns, which can cool the housing market and impact consumer spending.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real Estate
impacts.why: Higher borrowing costs typically reduce demand for new mortgages and housing construction.
